# Nantucket Tick Defense & Co-Infection Radar

> Real-time tick triage, 72-hour single-dose doxycycline prophylaxis assessment, repellents laboratory, and Seven Generations ecological stewardship for Nantucket Island.

## Core Capabilities
- [72-Hour Prophylaxis Assessment](http://localhost:8080/#radar): Computes transmission risk for Lyme (*Borrelia burgdorferi*), Babesiosis (*Babesia microti*), and Anaplasmosis (*Anaplasma phagocytophilum*).
- [Eisenhower Prioritization Matrix](http://localhost:8080/#eisenhower): Actionable 4-quadrant clinical guidance across acute attachment, 72h prophylaxis window, and 30-day symptom journals.
- [Repellent Armor Formulation Lab](http://localhost:8080/#repellents): Two-Zone protection guide comparing Permethrin 0.5% (clothing) and Picaridin 20% / PMD / DEET (skin).
- [Field Guides & Wikipedia Articles](http://localhost:8080/#articles): Deep dives into island ecology, Japanese Barberry eradication, and biomedical tick saliva pharmacology.
- [Satellite Spatial Radar & Eco-Routing](http://localhost:8080/#map): Interactive high-resolution satellite imagery with vector heatmaps and zero-brush paved corridors.
- [FHIR R4 Clinical Hand-Off](http://localhost:8080/#hospital): Generates de-identified HL7 FHIR R4 Bundle for emergency triage at Nantucket Cottage Hospital.
